explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D2 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward), when the agent chose a2, reached S2 by a common transition, and the previous trial was rewarded; any D1 or GO step, any a1 choice, any rare transition, any trial after an unrewarded one, and any trial before about 93 gives 0. In that case it is about 5 to 8 on the first such trial after an unrewarded or rare trial, and 9 to 10 when the previous trial was also one of these (a2, common to S2, rewarded).
